denominator_definitions.all_attempted_kb_requests: All frozen knowledge requests for which retrieval was attempted; not_applicable branches are excluded.
denominator_definitions.all_candidate_queries: All frozen Story Segment evaluation queries evaluated against the same runtime snapshot.
denominator_definitions.all_capacity_preflights: Every D-owned capacity preflight bound to the final typed shadow build input and target storage roots.
denominator_definitions.all_context_units: All context units selected into final grounded generation context across the frozen queries.
denominator_definitions.all_detected_story_occurrences: All source-query Story occurrences in the frozen direct-query authorization cases.
denominator_definitions.all_explicit_one_to_three_owner_cases: Frozen direct-query cases containing exactly one, two, or three explicit Story owners.
denominator_definitions.all_final_context_required_atom_groups: All required Atom groups for frozen cases after current context packing; each group contributes at most one covered item.
denominator_definitions.all_finalized_unaffected_subtasks: Every local, meta, smalltalk, and unrelated KB subtask that does not overlap a provisional-to-final Story fallback repair.
denominator_definitions.all_frozen_requests: All unique frozen requests, including non-retrieval boundary cases.
denominator_definitions.all_knowledge_subtasks: All knowledge subtasks in the frozen final RequestPlan v2 cases.
denominator_definitions.all_local_story_pipeline_samples: All timed local detector, assignment, authorization, mapping, aggregation, quota, and packing samples after warm-up.
denominator_definitions.all_non_story_kb_cases: All frozen non-Story knowledge cases and non-Story spans in composite cases.
denominator_definitions.all_nonexhaustive_answers: All frozen cases whose narrative coverage is non_exhaustive.
denominator_definitions.all_not_applicable_boundary_branches: All non-Story, denied, needs-continuation, boundary, and local branches that must be filtered before KB retrieval-outcome aggregation.
denominator_definitions.all_oversized_story_atoms: Every Story Atom exceeding the normal segment text budget in the accepted C artifact.
denominator_definitions.all_performance_responses: All five post-warm-up end-to-end candidate responses per frozen performance case.
denominator_definitions.all_protected_queries: All frozen numeric, short-text, and exact internal-ID queries paired to the accepted active baseline.
denominator_definitions.all_relevant_character_relations: All manually reviewable character-to-Story relations in the frozen relation subset.
denominator_definitions.all_required_story_authorizations: Every required Story owner in direct, verified-continuation, or validated-anchor cases.
denominator_definitions.all_retrieval_outcome_projections: Every internal RouteDecision, REST response, SSE sources event, and SSE done event projection in the frozen cases.
denominator_definitions.all_runtime_protected_identities: All active pointers, active artifacts, source snapshots, schemas, configs, MinIO/MySQL states, and production provenance protected by the shadow run.
denominator_definitions.all_story_answer_scope_cases: All applicable frozen Story evidence packets, repeated twice for deterministic normalization.
denominator_definitions.all_story_atom_citations: All Atom citations emitted from final Story context in the frozen cases.
denominator_definitions.all_story_dense_queries: Frozen semantic Story subset evaluated against typed Story Segment Dense rows.
denominator_definitions.all_story_mentions: All reviewed positive and negative Story mention candidates in the frozen request-level detector set.
denominator_definitions.all_story_segments_in_final_context: All selected Story Segments after fusion, owner quota, expansion, and context packing.
denominator_definitions.all_target_scope_applicability_decisions: Every target subtask's scope-presence decision in the frozen cases, including authorized Story, non-Story, local, denied, boundary, needs-continuation, and failed branches. Each target decision counts once; setup executions are excluded. Missing target execution or an incomplete target set is unmeasured, not removed to claim complete coverage.
denominator_definitions.all_topic_page_requirements: All required Topic/Page source identities in the frozen Topic plus Story cases.
denominator_definitions.all_typed_dense_input_rows: All rows in the clean-HEAD typed Dense build input.
denominator_definitions.all_unique_source_spans: All frozen RequestPlan v2 SourceQuerySpan occurrences that must have exactly one final subtask owner.
denominator_definitions.all_valid_anchor_events: All frozen anchor set, clear, expiry, snapshot-mismatch, and consume events.
denominator_definitions.all_valid_continuation_pages: All canonical pages derived from frozen explicit 4 through 32 Story requests and revalidated in a new request.
denominator_definitions.all_valid_finalizations: All frozen provisional to final RequestPlan v2 transactions.
denominator_definitions.all_wrong_or_ambiguous_detection_cases: All frozen incomplete, ambiguous, cross-span, duplicate-span, Planner omission, Planner addition, and Planner reorder Story cases.
denominator_definitions.baseline_middle_late_subset: Required Atom groups in the frozen middle/late subset whose active final-context Recall is below 0.90.
denominator_definitions.candidate_retrieval_latency_samples: All five post-warm-up candidate retrieval timings per frozen performance case.
denominator_definitions.exact_lexical_atom_groups: All required Atom groups in the 12-case exact lexical, numeric, short-dialogue, and internal-ID stratum.
denominator_definitions.fused_story_atom_groups_at_8: All required Atom groups mechanically mapped to relevant Segments for fused top-8 scoring.
denominator_definitions.fused_story_ranked_cases: All frozen cases with at least one mechanically derived relevant Segment in fused top-8 evaluation.
denominator_definitions.multi_detail_required_atom_groups: Every independent required Atom group in the 10 single-Story multi-detail cases.
denominator_definitions.published_character_relations: All character-to-Story relations emitted by the accepted published relation registry.
denominator_definitions.semantic_story_atom_groups: All required Atom groups in the frozen semantic Story subset.
denominator_definitions.shortfall_cases_with_relevant_final_cont: Frozen partial cases with at least one relevant gold Atom visible in final context.
denominator_definitions.story_branch_expansions: All adjacency expansions from selected Story Segments in the frozen branch-boundary cases.
denominator_definitions.story_context_character_pairs: Every pair of Story context units compared for duplicate normalized body text.
denominator_definitions.story_owner_filtered_results: All retrieval results returned from an authorized Story owner-scoped branch.
denominator_definitions.story_query_execution_plans: Every frozen Story query execution plan inspected for query-time full-corpus scans.
denominator_definitions.zero_tolerance_event_set: Count of the named forbidden event across the complete frozen run; denominator is one complete run.
